Speech-to-speech translation is moving from cascaded pipelines to end-to-end models that listen, translate and speak in a single system. Many core questions remain open. How do you translate simultaneously, before the speaker has finished? How do you keep translated speech natural and expressive? How do large multimodal models best combine speech understanding, translation and speech generation? And how should these systems be evaluated? As an intern, you will own a focused research project on one of these questions, working closely with researchers and engineers on the team. You will have access to large-scale data and compute, and we encourage publishing results at top venues. Example research directions include: - Streaming and simultaneous speech translation: policies for when to listen and when to speak, and the trade-off between quality and latency. - Speech generation for translation: natural, expressive and prosodically appropriate output, including speech tokenizers and audio codecs. - Multimodal foundation models for speech: how pre-training, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning shape speech-to-speech ability across languages. - Multilingual scaling: extending to new languages and handling code-switching and unknown source languages. - Evaluation: automatic metrics and human evaluation methods that reflect real conversational experience.22:Tffa,Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. Interaction et mémoire — Entraîner des agents capables d’évoluer dans des environnements de développement, d’exécuter du code, d’interpréter la rétroaction des outils et des tests, d’améliorer leurs résultats de façon itérative et de conserver en mémoire ce qui s’est produit. Génération d’environnements synthétiques et de données — Créer à la demande des environnements dans lesquels les agents peuvent exercer leurs compétences. Interaction & Memory — Training agents that can operate within development environments, execute code, interpret feedback from tools and tests, and iteratively refine their outputs and maintain a memory of what happened. Synthetic Environment and Data Generation – Creating environments on demand where agents can practice their skills. Realizing this vision requires addressing several open technical challenges, such as a significant reduction in model training/encoding time and more efficient compression. As part of the Video Algorithms team during this 24-week Fall internship, you will help us investigate the potential of GS as a future streaming format and explore possible improvements, with a focus on building towards a practical system.
